metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1928 · The Passion of Joan of Arc
metas.description: In 1431, Jeanne d'Arc is placed on trial on charges of heresy, and the ecclesiastical jurists attempt to force her to recant her claims of holy visions.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1935 · Mutiny on the Bounty
metas.description: First mate Fletcher Christian leads a revolt against his sadistic commander, Captain Bligh, in this classic seafaring adventure, based on the real-life 1789 mutiny.
